sections.title: Sound of iksz
paragraphs: The letter is named (iksz) /iks/. Its main sound is heard in (xilofon) /ˈksilofon/, which means xylophone. This letter has two sounds. Both sounds appear only in borrowed words.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: First lift the back of your tongue to touch the roof. Stop the air, then let it burst out. Straight after that, push air over the tongue tip to make a hiss. For the first sound, keep your voice off. For the second sound, turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter usually sounds like the consonant cluster in (taxi) /ˈtɒksi/. It keeps this voiceless sound at the start of words, as in (xilofon) /ˈksilofon/. Between two vowels in certain borrowed words, it turns into a voiced sound, as in (egzotikus) /ˈɛɡzotikuʃ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: At the start of a word, do not say a single z sound like in zebra. Always say both sounds clearly, like the cs in ducks. When it is between vowels, do not soften it into a simple s sound like in basic.
